_comment: SimVQA calibration for the FFW_SG2 AI Worker used by kitchen collection. This is distinct from ai_worker_bg2.json, which describes the BG2 system-identification embodiment.
_dataset_frame_derivation: Inverse of the shared simulated dataset encoding in ActionManager.action_absolute and kitchen/mdp/observations.ee_6d_pos: p_dataset = p_base + R*[0,0,-0.10956] + [0.095,0,-0.823356]. These offsets decode simulated data; they are not measured AI Worker hardware calibration.

vqa._comment: Link and joint names from Robots/MM/aiworker/ffw_sg2.usd. Gripper closure uses one revolute joint's displacement in radians from its reset reading.
